# vendor/

Read-only copies of the open-source (MIT) libraries we build from, so their source is searchable in this repo.
Do not edit or import from here. Install into `src/components/` with the shadcn CLI instead.

- `kokonutui/`: https://github.com/kokonut-labs/kokonutui (components, hooks, registry, docs). See `docs/kokonut.md`.
- `watermelon-platform/`: https://github.com/WatermelonCorp/watermelon-platform (components, animated components, blocks, dashboards, templates). See `docs/watermelon.md`.

Exact commits: `SOURCES.json`. Refresh both: `npm run vendor:sync`. Site code, images and build tooling are left out; each folder keeps its LICENSE.
